name: UI Review
author: Brett
description: Every UI a build makes, filed for Brett to look at; a merge gate only while the switch 'UI Review is a merge gate' is on (default off since Nov 13 2026: uiReview.gate = Claude setting builds.uiReviewGate; GET/POST gate, release-held), one section per kind (open registry: Design packs, Whole apps / programs, Screens & pages, Settings interfaces, Dialogs & popups, Menus & toolbars, Banners & cards, Other). Each item carries its app, build, branch and PR, desktop + phone screenshots, notes, a status (waiting, approved, changes asked, rejected), his comment and its history. Views: tree, collapsible grid, grid with sub-grids, gallery and side-by-side compare, all with multi-select and bulk Approve / Ask changes / Reject. Builds submit through review.mjs, POST /api/plugins/ui-review/submit or rebuild-shots --submit; other plugins read the per-branch / per-PR state through the ui-review@1 capability. Design packs (formerly their own plugin) are one section: pick up to 3. Screenshots tab (ui-screenshot@1): ad-hoc pictures (check sessions, live captures, PR before/after, uploads) that never enter the approve / reject queue, saved with axf shot / POST shots / Upload; grid grouped by app, screen, source or day, thumbnails, full-screen viewer with before/after slider, copy link, delete, Send to review. Predicted looks (ui-prediction@1): when a build that changes UI is launched, framework/cli/ui-predict.mjs makes a mockup of each screen it will touch (framework controls, current theme, demo data) and files it here as 'Predicted - approve the look' next to the screen as it is now; Approve look / Ask changes (the comment goes to the build) / Reject. The predicted pictures refresh while the build runs and the real after-shots replace them at the end (badge Real, predicted vs real compare).

items.title: How many options a build ships, and whether Brett is asked first
items.description: How many options every build must ship for a UI (never under 3), whether Brett is asked how many first, and how long that question waits before the default is taken.

items.title: Change the choices settings
items.description: Changes the choices settings: the minimum number of options a build ships (3 or more), Ask me how many options on or off, and the minutes a question waits for Brett's answer.

items.title: Brett's pick for an item's options, in priority order (only what he said)
items.description: Records Brett's pick for a UI Review item's options: the option ids he chose in priority order (the first is the default view), with an optional comment; only his own click or axHub approval may call it.

items.title: Read Brett's pick for an item
items.description: Reads Brett's pick for a UI Review item: which options he chose, in priority order, or that he hasn't decided yet; a build waits on it before building the picked views.

items.title: Every option asset saved, picked or not
items.description: Lists every option asset a build shipped through UI Review, picked or not, optionally one asset type only; each is in the asset library and in Settings → Appearance → Choose from every asset.

items.title: A build asks Brett how many options to make
items.description: A build asks Brett how many options it should make for a UI before it makes them (when Ask me how many options is on); the question shows in the console and on AmberX and times out to the default.

items.title: Questions waiting for Brett's answer
items.description: The questions about option counts still waiting for Brett's answer, with the build and title of each.

items.title: Read one question's answer (the default once the wait runs out)
items.description: Reads one option-count question's answer: Brett's count, or the default once the wait ran out.

items.title: Brett's answer: how many options
items.description: Brett's answer to an option-count question: how many options the build should make (3 or more); only his own click or axHub approval may call it.

items.title: List predicted looks
items.description: Every predicted look (ui-prediction@1) in UI Review, or one build's, with its look gate verdict (go / wait / held) and the 'wait for my look approval' setting.
items.output: { settings, items: ui-review-item@1[] with verdict, verdict? }

items.title: Predict a build's look
items.description: Make (or refresh) a build's predicted item: the mockup pictures (predicted-*.png) and the screen as it is now (before-*.png). framework/cli/ui-predict.mjs predict <build> makes the pictures and calls this.

items.title: Real shots replace the predicted look
items.description: The build finished: its real after-shots replace the mockup (badge Real); the item waits for the real approval, the look decision and the predicted pictures stay for the compare.

items.title: Decide a predicted look
items.description: Brett's decision on a build's predicted look: approve, changes (the comment goes to the build as an addendum) or reject (the build is held).

items.title: Look approval setting (retired)
items.description: 'Wait for my look approval before UI builds start' (waitForLook). Retired Nov 13 2026: UI Review is not a gate, the launcher never waits for a look whatever it says.

items.title: Set the look approval setting (retired)
items.description: Stores 'Wait for my look approval before UI builds start' for old clients. Retired Nov 13 2026: it has no effect, UI Review is not a gate.

items.title: Is UI Review a merge gate? (default off)
items.description: Reads the switch 'UI Review is a merge gate' (uiReview.gate = the Claude setting builds.uiReviewGate, default off): {on, heldPrs, openReviews, line}. Off: items are filed for Brett to look at, PRs never wait. The same object as review.mjs gate, the console action ui-review.gate and voice uireview.gate. Deep link: console_show target settings:plugins/ui-review#gate.
items.output: { $axf: 'ui-review-gate@1', key, label, on, heldPrs: number[], openReviews: [{pr, branch, review, held}], line, who }

items.title: Turn 'UI Review is a merge gate' on or off
items.description: Turns the switch off (open to everyone) or on (personOnly: only Brett's own click in the console, like the owner-only Claude setting; any other caller gets 403). Answers the gate object plus {changed}. Same as review.mjs gate on|off and voice uireview.gate on|off.

items.title: Release PRs held for UI Review into the merge queue
items.description: For each PR (prs, or all = every PR with an open review): its UI Review items become non-blocking (still filed for Brett to look at), a draft PR is marked ready for review, and the PR is added to the merge queue (queue add). Only through the merge queue: it never merges. dryRun says what it would do. Same as review.mjs release-held and voice uireview.release.
items.output: { ok, dryRun, prs: [{ pr, items, draft, queue }] }

items.title: Mark PRs' UI Review items non-blocking (still filed)
items.description: release-held's UI Review half only: the open review items of these PRs (or all) become non-blocking. They stay filed and keep their status; nothing is approved.

items.title: Voice: release PRs held for UI Review
items.description: AmberX voice name for release-held: 'uireview.release 557 553' or 'uireview.release all' runs POST release (items non-blocking, un-draft, merge queue add; never merges).

items.title: Is UI Review a merge gate?
items.description: In the open console: reads GET gate ({on, heldPrs, line}); with 'on' or 'off' it sets the switch (on is Brett's own click only).

items.title: Voice: UI Review gate status, on or off
items.description: AmberX voice name for the gate switch: 'uireview.gate' reads it, 'uireview.gate off' turns it off, 'uireview.gate on' turns it on only when Brett himself asks in the console.
